rust_summary: a death-protection item about to save an entity, cancellable (`native_living_use_totem`).
doc_summary: a totem about to save a player or a mob from a killing blow: `native_living_use_totem(entity, kind, source, hand, item, cancel)`, as `LivingEntity.checkTotemDeathProtection` finds a `death_protection` item in `hand` (`Hand::Main` or `Hand::Off`). Set `cancel` and the entity gets no protection: it dies and keeps the item. A source that bypasses invulnerability never asks. `native_player_totem` still hears a server player's totem that saved them, after this.
